newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal's Portucel raises pulp price.
newsitem.headline: Portugal's Portucel raises pulp price.

text.p: Portuguese pulp group Portucel Industrial-Empresa Produtora de Celulose will raise the price of white eucalyptus pulp by 30 Ecus per tonne to 450 Ecus per tonne effective from October 1, the company said on Monday.
"This is the third price increase since June and reflects the strengthening of the market, in particular since the end of the first half of the year," a statement said.

"The recent improvements in prospects for growth of European economies and consumption indicators in the pulp and paper sectors, namely in the quality segments, point to more normal operational conditions in the second half (of the year)," it added.
Portucel shares rose slightly on Lisbon bourse after the announcement and stood at 1,047 escudos, up five, in volume of 43,053 shares in late morning trade.
